issue.message: lookupOrder is a get with 2 inputs (FD17, FD11). A get takes no inputs, or the one field the user types to find its record. Keep that field and move the others to the operation that saves or lists.

entries.reason: Changed lookupOrder from get to list so both order reference and phone number remain as filter inputs.

issue.message: S05 lets the buyer enter a DiscountCode and shows the resulting discount but reads only Piece records. Fix: Add getDiscountCodeByCode to the reads for S05 so it reads listPieces and the DiscountCode applied at checkout.

entries.reason: Added getDiscountCodeByCode to S05 reads so the discount code applied at checkout is loaded.

issue.message: F07.S02 reads Order, but no get operation on Order serves it.

entries.reason: Added F07.S02 to getOrder so the Order read is served by a get; lookupOrder list still covers reference and phone filters.
